summary: Flexport is US internet-based freight forwarding company, founded in 2013. About 2,082 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 75% of its 4 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 2 about funding; 2 about growth or hiring.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: US freight forwarding tech company with an Amsterdam office and IND-recognised Dutch entities; it is pushing hard into AI tools for booking freight.

culture.text: Its mission is to make global trade easier with technology; customers move more than $19B of goods across 112 countries a year through it.
All 4 open jobs here are in Amsterdam, mostly sales and account management at mid to senior level.

open.text: Three Dutch entities, including Flexport International B.V., are IND recognised visa sponsors.
3 of its 4 open jobs here (75%) don't ask for Dutch.

growth.text: Expanded its fulfilment network to Canada and the UK.
Reported $1.5B annual recurring revenue in 2024 and an $8B valuation in 2022.

worth_knowing.text: A headline says Flexport's losses are mounting again and its paper value has dropped again.
Launched tools that let AI agents book, track and optimise freight on its platform.
A US maritime judge rejected Peloton's $33.7 million demurrage claim against Flexport.
